_comment: Mastering Mixology (docs/mastering-mixology.md). potions: indexed as the cache does (enum 5542, the lab multilocs, the order varbits); paste is units of 10 per letter, xp is for an ordered potion (an unordered one gives a third), resin is what an ordered potion pays. refiner: paste per herb or unfinished potion. All from the OSRS Wiki.

goggles._comment: Prescription goggles (mm_alchemist_hat, and the _alt look): a 10% chance, rolled once per potion, to keep its secondaries (Wiki: Prescription goggles). A torstol potion (unf) in a super combat potion or anti-venom+ counts as a secondary; crystal dust (divine potions) never does.

shopDescriptions.mixology_stock_low_potion_pack: <col=ffffff>Requires level 60 Herblore.</col> A pack of potions made by an apprentice alchemist.
shopDescriptions.mixology_stock_med_potion_pack: <col=ffffff>Requires level 70 Herblore.</col> A pack of potions made by an adept alchemist.
shopDescriptions.mixology_stock_high_potion_pack: <col=ffffff>Requires level 85 Herblore.</col> A pack of potions made by an expert alchemist.
shopDescriptions.mixology_stock_alchemist_goggles: Provides a 10% chance to save your secondary ingredient when mixing potions.
shopDescriptions.mixology_stock_alchemist_gloves: No science is done without proper gloves.
shopDescriptions.mixology_stock_reagents_pouch: A pouch for storing herblore potion ingredients.
shopDescriptions.mixology_stock_potion_storage: Unlocks the ability to store potions within a separate area of the bank.
shopDescriptions.mixology_stock_prepot: An item that can be freely assembled to allow you to consume many potions in a single action, such as combat boosting potions.
shopDescriptions.mixology_stock_amulet: Useful when making potions - has the chance of giving an extra dose. Amulets of chemistry can be used on this amulet to give it 10 charges for each one. <col=ffffff>Upon purchasing this amulet, you will also receive 50 free charges.</col>
shopDescriptions.mixology_stock_juice: A secondary ingredient for making Goading potions (54 Herblore) and Prayer regeneration potions (58 Herblore).
